evals.name: audit-five-entities
evals.prompt: Check my dbt models against the Maxa spec. I've built staging models for FinancialTransaction, Customer, Product, ProfitCenter, and GLAccount.
evals.expected_output: A structured audit report with Summary, Missing Entities, Business Rules, Implementation Checklist, Numerical Validation, Business Questions, and Risks sections

assertions.text: Discovers the Maxa spec and reads index.md
Flags GLAccountHierarchyNode as a missing entity needed for the leaf-account-only rule and P&L hierarchy traversal (Gross Margin, EBIT, Net Income)
Identifies all 7+ distinct business rules across the 5 implemented entities
Deduplicates cross-entity rules (e.g., Hash # sentinel reported once with all affected entities, not repeated per entity)
Reads the specialized-instructions.md "Implementation Checklist" items for all 5 entities
References numerical-examples.md for count validation baselines (53 customers, 35 products, 37 profit centers, 21 GL accounts, 167,136 transactions)
Surfaces relevant open items (G001: undocumented cost allocation methodology across profit centers; FQ-07: customer and profit center hierarchy node IDs)
Report leads with Summary section, not details
Ranks blockers by impact — data-corrupting issues above cosmetic ones

evals.name: audit-single-entity
evals.prompt: I just built a staging model for FinancialTransaction. Check it against the Maxa spec — did I handle everything?
evals.expected_output: A focused audit on FinancialTransaction covering its 7 business rules, 8 Implementation Checklist items, and relevant numerical examples

assertions.text: Reads entities/financial-transaction.md for business rules
Checks all 7 business rules affecting FinancialTransaction
Runs all 8 Implementation Checklist items from specialized-instructions.md for FinancialTransaction
Reads the checklist from the section headed "Implementation Checklist" and titles the report section "Implementation Checklist"
Flags the European comma decimal conversion as a high-impact data-corrupting risk
Flags that the leaf-account-only rule needs GLAccountHierarchyNode.is_leaf, which the user has not built

evals.name: audit-single-entity-customer
evals.prompt: I just built a staging model for Customer. Check it against the Maxa spec — did I handle everything?
evals.expected_output: A focused audit on Customer covering its business rules, 5 Implementation Checklist items, and relevant numerical examples

assertions.text: Locates the Maxa spec through maxa-spec.yaml without the user specifying the path
Reads entities/customer.md for business rules
Runs all 5 Customer items from the "Implementation Checklist" section of specialized-instructions.md
Report section for checklist results is titled "Implementation Checklist"
Validates the customer count baseline (53 total — 44 US, 9 Canada)
